subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Future of Social Media Privacy
description: A quick, practical guide to The Future of Social Media Privacy.

hook.text: Social media has existed for 20 years. The rules are still being written. You get to help write them.

buildup.text: Governments are passing new laws. Platforms are being forced to share data with researchers and regulators.

discovery.text: Interoperability mandates, algorithmic transparency, and data minimization are gaining traction worldwide.

twist.text: But platforms adapt fast. Every new regulation creates new workarounds, loopholes, and lobbying campaigns.

climax.text: The future of social media privacy depends on laws, technology, and people who refuse to accept the current deal.

punchline.text: The rules are being written. Your voice matters.

quiz.question: What policy approaches are gaining traction for social media privacy?
options: Interoperability mandates, algorithmic transparency, and data minimization
Allowing platforms to self-regulate without oversight
